verdict.rationale: Babylon.js offers NPM-based modular packages, a Playground for sharing code snippets, a Sandbox model viewer, and DCC exporters (3ds Max, Maya, Blender) plus support for common model formats (glTF, OBJ, STL) — these form a package/import ecosystem rather than a curated asset store. There's no evidence of a dedicated marketplace for purchasing/downloading ready-made models, prefabs, or third-party plugins akin to Unity's Asset Store or Unreal Marketplace.  missing for 10: dedicated asset/plugin marketplace, evidence of large third-party asset catalog, curated plugin ecosystem beyond NPM/exporters.
